title: HF2123 (2023-2024 Regular): Retired peace officers authorized to possess firearms in Capitol complex.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2023-02-20; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/93/2023/0/HF/2123/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Version read: introduced text as filed (2023-02-20). No votes recorded. Bill strikes only an 'or' and a period to make room for new clause (5).

operative_text:
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 609.66, subd. 1g): (2) possesses a dangerous weapon, ammunition, or explosives in any state building within the Capitol Area described in chapter 15B, other than the National Guard Armory.
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 609.66, subd. 1g): (5) licensed peace officers and retired peace officers who carry pistols as authorized by, and in compliance with, United States Code, title 18, part I, chapter 44, section 926C, in buildings in the Capitol Area.
